title: Existing read date, activity and email runtime validation
readDates: Finite RFC3339 strings with calendar/time validation, or finite PostgreSQL Date instances within years 0000–9999. Declared nullable dates remain allowed. Date-only strings and JavaScript-normalized impossible dates are rejected. Valid responses retain existing fields and precision.
failure: Sanitized no-store 503; reads roll back and invalid booking mutation results roll back before audit/commit
workspaceActivity: At most 20 entries; only account_created, email_configuration_changed, test_email_accepted; explicit action/created_at projection
nativeEmail: Callable EMAIL binding; uncoerced addresses normalized to bare emails; actual nonempty trimmed messageId string without control characters, read once. Malformed receipt is a generic delivery error. Failed recovery removes its reset code; failed test email writes no acceptance audit.
templates: Known static IDs, bounded plain-text content, canonical required variables, valid placeholders; HTML escaping retained; untrusted required arrays ignored; native delivery remains the only transport.
